questions.qtext:
A person starts typing the numbers from 1 to 1999. He press the keys total ‘n’ number of times.
The value of n is
questions.solution:
(a)
The number of times he pressed the keys for one digit number = 9
The number of times he pressed the keys for two digit numbers = 90 × 2 = 180
The numbers of times he pressed the keys for three digit numbers = 900 × 3 = 2700
The number of times he pressed the keys for the numbers 1000 to 1999 is 1000 × 4 = 4000
Thus, total number of times the keys are pressed = 6889

questions.qtext:
Below is a sentence of which some parts have been jumbled up. Rearrange these parts which are labelled P, Q, R and S to produce the correct sentence. Choose the proper sequence. It would
P : that they were quite in the dark
Q : about the policy of management
R : appear from their statement
S : in dealing with the strike
The proper sequence should be
questions.solution:
(b)
“It would appear ...” can be the only coherent beginning of the sentence. Thus the first part
would be R. Since R says “their statement”, sentence P would follow it because it also says, “that they ...”
Thus, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.qtext:
If you are a brisk walker, there is no need to go to a gym. Your neighbourhood can become your gym. You don’t need fancy equipment to get a good exercise either. All you need is a welldesigned pair of shoes.
The paragraph best supports the statement that

options.text: poorly designed shoes can cause major foot injuries.
walking outdoors provides a better workout than walking indoors.
a gym membership is a poor investment.
brisk walking is a convenient and valuable form of exercise

questions.solution:
(d)
By stating that brisk walking does not require commute to a gym, the author stresses the
convenience of this form of exercise. The paragraph also states that brisk walking may result in a good workout.
Option (c) is not appropriate. A gym membership can be a good investment for some.
Option (b) is not given in the passage.
Option (a) seems logical but the paragraph does not mention it.
Option (d) is the most appropriate option.

questions.qtext: Which of the following is not an effect of fly ash on cement concrete?

options.text: It improves the resistance of concrete to sulphate attack.
It reduces the heat of hydration in concrete.
It increases the permeability of concrete.
It slows the rate of gain of strength in early days.

questions.solution:
(c)
The permeability of concrete reduces on addition of fly ash to cement. 28 days permeability of
fly-ash-concrete may be three times as that of ordinary concrete but after 6 months it may be less
than 0.25 times. So, it reduces the overall permeability of concrete.

questions.qtext: In remote sensing, which of the following correctly matches the type of resolution with the aspect it defines in an image?

options.text: Spatial resolution – Ability to distinguish between two closely spaced wavelength bands.
Spectral resolution – Refers to the sensitivity of the system to small changes in the wavelength
Temporal resolution – Frequency of image acquisition over the same area
Radiometric resolution – Sharpness or clarity of surface details in an image

questions.solution:
(c)
Spatial resolution – Ability of the remote sensing system to record spatial details.
Spectral resolution – Wavelength to which the remote sensing system is sensitive.
Radiometric resolution – Sensitivity of the system to small changes in the radiation (wavelength).

questions.qtext: Which of the following statement(s) is/are incorrect ?

options.text: An element in plane stress can never be in state of plane strain.
An element in plane stress is always in state of plane strain.
If an element is in state of triaxial stress, then stresses acting on element are principal stresses.
Planes of maximum shear strains are inclined at 45° to direction of principle strains.

questions.solution:
(a, b)
An element in plane stress can’t be in state of plane strain except when Poisson’s ratio is zero or
when normal stresses acting on element are equal and opposite.
